config.summary_text:
AReno training config

Algorithm
---------
  name              gspo
  default_loss      gspo_loss_fn
  requires_rollout  yes

Inputs
------
  ckpt            $MODEL
  dataset_path    $GSM8K_TRAIN
  model_hub       modelscope
  dataset_loader  examples/math/dataset_loader.py
  reward_fn       examples/math/math_verify_reward.py
  reward_ckpt     none
  agent_fn        none

Runtime
-------
  world_size    1
  tp_size       1
  dp_size       1
  devices       0
  attn_backend  flash
  thinking      False

Rollout
-------
  batch_size           32
  max_prompt_tokens    512
  max_new_tokens       1024
  max_context_len      model limit
  topology             shared with train engine
  policy_sync          shared weights
  n_samples            8
  max_running_prompts  128
  sampling             greedy=no, temperature=1.0, top_k=-1, top_p=1.0

Training
--------
  max_steps                           100
  sequence_parallel                   model config (resolved at load)
  mini_bs                             16
  score_micro_bs                      8
  gradient_accumulation_steps         auto
  qlora                               no
  lora_rank                           disabled
  lora_alpha                          n/a
  lora_dropout                        n/a
  lora_target_modules                 n/a
  lora_adapter_path                   n/a
  optimizer                           lr=1e-06, min_lr=1e-07, decay=cosine/1000, betas=(0.9, 0.999),
                                      weight_decay=0.01, adam_8bit=no, adam_4bit=no
  optimizer_state_offload             none
  optimizer_state_offload_dir         none
  optimizer_state_offload_batch_size  1
  grad_clip_norm                      1.0

Outputs
-------
  save_path        runs/rl/actc_s1/ckpt
  save_interval    50
  export_gguf      none
  gguf_file_type   disabled
  metrics_log_dir  runs/rl/actc_s1/tb
